description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 21 LTS. Update build configurations (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 21. Address any compilation issues related to deprecated APIs or language changes.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Java from version 1.8 to version 21 (LTS). Updated maven.compiler.source and maven.compiler.target to 21, upgraded maven-compiler-plugin to 3.11.0, migrated from javax.* to jakarta.* APIs (servlet and websocket). All builds pass and tests succeed.

tasks.description: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4 (latest LTS)
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4 and Spring Framework to 6.x. Migrate javax.* packages to jakarta.* namespace. Update Spring Boot dependencies and configurations. Address breaking changes in Spring Boot 3.x migration.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully migrated from plain Jakarta EE web application to Spring Boot 3.4.2 with Spring Framework 6.2.2. Converted both demo (web) and democlient (CLI) modules to use Spring Boot starters. Migrated RabbitMQ integration to Spring AMQP and WebSocket to Spring WebSocket. All builds pass and tests succeed.
